name: investigate
description: Source-only scope, bounded hypotheses/evidence gathering, independent accounting and explicit confirmed/rejected/inconclusive cause with next actions. Never repairs or claims runtime reproduction.
whenToUse: Investigate a specific problem whose cause is unclear before deciding whether to run bug-fix; source inspection only.

phases.title: scope
phases.detail: Bound source scope to at most 40 files

phases.title: gather
phases.detail: Form bounded hypotheses backed by source evidence

phases.title: check
phases.detail: Independently account for every hypothesis and report next actions
